title: Search
inputLabel: Search for an id or text
placeholder: Transaction id, trace id, user:<id>, req:<id> or a service, SQL or instance name
help: Digits up to 20 are a transaction id, 32 hex digits a trace id. user: and req: search the selected time range (at most 24 hours). Other text searches service names, SQL and instances.
tooLong: The search text is longer than {{bytes, number}} bytes. Shorten it.

start.title: Enter what to look for
start.description: Type a transaction id, a trace id, user:<user id>, req:<request id> or part of a service, SQL or instance name, then press Enter.

rangeRequired.title: Choose a time range of at most 24 hours
rangeRequired.description: User id and request id searches read the selected time range, which must be 24 hours or shorter. Pick a shorter range in the time range picker and search again.

tooShort.title: Type a few more characters
tooShort.description: Text searches need at least {{count, number}} characters.

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.descriptionId: No transaction or trace has this id in the kept data. Check the id, or open the XLog around the time it ran.
empty.descriptionRange: Nothing matched in the selected time range. Widen the range (at most 24 hours) or check the value.
empty.descriptionText: No service, SQL or instance name contains this text. Try a shorter part of the name.

notCollected.all: User ids are not collected: every instance of this environment runs with the user id mode off. Turn on capture.user-id.mode in the agent configuration to search by user.
notCollected.some: {{off, number}} of {{total, number}} instances do not collect user ids (user id mode off); their transactions cannot be found by user id.

caption: Search results

error.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a minute and search again.
error.rateLimitedRetry: Too many searches. Search again in {{seconds, number}} s.
error.hashUnavailable: This application stores hashed user ids and its salt cannot be read now. Try again later or ask an administrator to check the server.
error.rangeInvalid: The time range is not valid for this search. Choose a range of at most 24 hours.
error.queryInvalid: The search text is not valid for this kind of search. Check it and search again.
